lastCompletedStory.title: Align cam-plan prose with the read-from-main backlog seam

openQuestions: US-001's open question (a latent selectFn-throw gap in buildProductionDispatchFn's meta_loop=auto dispatch path, src/commands/sidecar.ts ~1504/1509) is still unresolved and out of scope for US-002/US-003/US-004; carry it forward as a follow-up-story candidate, not something to fix opportunistically.
nextStoryContext: US-002 is done: both cam-plan.md copies (.claude/commands/ and templates/commands/) now state that main:scripts/cam/issues/ (the readBacklogFromMain seam) is the single source of truth for BOTH the no-argument and argument-N resolution paths, with the working-tree `ls scripts/cam/issues/` listing explicitly labeled fallback-only (fires only when `git ls-tree main` fails, e.g. a fresh repo with no issues dir on main yet). Ran `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts after touching templates/, then `bun run embed-vendor:check` is clean. Full quality spine (bun run check:all: test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) is green. US-003 (remove dead clock/ClockFn from ship-finalize.ts) and US-004 (clear stale review findings on CLEAN) remain, both independent of US-002's edits (no shared files) and can proceed without extra setup.
